'''Dace Golliard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] officer during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. He later became a member of [[The Crucible]] slavery organization. Golliard was the [[Fleet Captain/Legends|Fleet Captain]] of the [[Gladiator (Crucible)|''Gladiator'']].

==Biography==
===Member of the Crucible===
{{Dialogue|Crewman #1|Was this guy really in the Republic Navy?|Crewman #2|Once. Sith hit his ship before his court-martial met. He was starving in the brig when we pulled him out of derelict. Did fine in the ''pits'' though&mdash;killed every survivor who'd been in his crew.|Golliard|And a lot of ''them'' actually did their jobs.|attr=Two ''Gladiator'' crewmen and Golliard|src=<ref name="KotOR 44" />}}
During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Dace Golliard served as an [[Republic officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]].<ref name="KotOR 44" /> When [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces under the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] attacked the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]],<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 1]]</ref> Golliard fled the battle.<ref name="KotOR 49">[[Knights of the Old Republic 49|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 49]]</ref> Eventually, he was recaptured and was set to be court-martialed. However, Sith forces attacked the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] transporting Golliard, leaving him in the ship's brig. Members of [[The Crucible]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] organization enslaved the survivors of the Sith's attack on the ship, taking Golliard and the survivors to the Crucible's dueling pits. Golliard killed all of his former crew members in the dueling pits. He advanced in the Crucible's ranks, leading raids on various planets to find more slaves. Golliard eventually became the [[Captain/Legends|captain]]<ref name="KotOR 45">[[Knights of the Old Republic 45|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 45]]</ref> of the warship [[Gladiator (Crucible)|''Gladiator'']].<ref name="KotOR 44" />

During Golliard's time with the Crucible, he dealt with [[Demagol|Antos Wyrick]], the [[Professor/Legends|professor]] of the [[New Generation Academy]] on [[Osadia]]. Wyrick bargained with Golliard and the Crucible for more [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|Arkanian offshoot]] families for his biological experiments.<ref name="KotOR 45" /><ref name="KotOR 48">[[Knights of the Old Republic 48|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 48]]</ref> At some point, Wyrick gave Golliard his daughter, [[Chantique]],<ref name="KotOR 49" /> to enslave in exchange for a shipment of offshoot families.<ref name="KotOR 45" /> Golliard eventually led a raid against Wyrick's school and captured his students<ref name="KotOR 44" /> while the professor was away on a trip.<ref name="KotOR 48" /> He captured the female Arkanian offshoot [[Jarael|Edessa]], who had fled Wyrick's academy during the attack.<ref name="KotOR 44" />

===Reunion with "Snow-Hair"===
In [[3963 BBY]], Captain Golliard responded to a distress call from [[Sariyah Budan]], leader of the [[Sungrazer cooperative]], a client of the Crucible located in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]]. Two beings, [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Jarael]], had posed as Crucible agents in order to infiltrate the cooperative and free the slave miners that worked the comets.<ref name="KotOR 43" /> Golliard immediately recognized Jarael as a young child he had captured many years earlier. He ordered his [[skyreaper drone]]s to attack the ''[[Hot Prospect]]'', the mining ship that the slaves were being taken to. As Golliard ordered a boarding party to attack the ship, the ''Hot Prospect'' fired its mining drill into the bridge of the ''Gladiator'', causing it to decompress. The warship suffered further damage when it was hit by mining explosives launched by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] renegade [[Rohlan Dyre]]. Golliard ordered the surviving skyreapers to attack the mining ship, but Carrick shut off the ''Hot Prospect''{{'s}} centrifuge, sending it into a spin that tore it away and enabled it to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Golliard was severely punished by [[Chantique]] for his failure to apprehend Jarael and Carrick, but his life was spared by [[Bar'injar]], who still required his knowledge.<ref name="KotOR 44" />

Golliard later found Carrick adrift in an [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|''Aurek''-class]] fighter, under the alias of [[Carth Onasi|Carth]] [[Kamlin]], a Republic officer escorting the ''[[Vindication]]''. Golliard could tell that the fighter was salvage and discovered a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] in it, immediately putting the Crucible on Carrick's plot.<ref name="KotOR 45" />

===Brought to justice===
[[File:Karath_and_Golliard.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Golliard is arrested by Admiral Karath.]]
After the Crucible fled from Volgax, Golliard went into hiding. Soon, however, Zayne Carrick realized that Golliard knew the location of Osadia, and became determined to track him down and retrieve the information so that he could save Jarael. Carrick called in his debt with Cassus Fett, who staged an attack in order to lure Admiral Saul Karath to a mining facility near the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ithor system]]. At the same time, he released a signal announcing his intent. Golliard swallowed the bait and moved the ship behind some asteroids in order to capture any survivors as slaves. The Mandalorians suddenly fled, and Zayne contacted Admiral Karath, informing him of Golliard's presence nearby. Since he still nursed a grudge against Golliard for causing his father's death, Karath was all too eager to help bring Golliard down. The ''Gladiator'' was disabled and brought aboard with a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. In a last-ditch effort, Golliard used an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to flee to the surface, hoping to find a shuttle offworld. However, Carrick used the skyreaper control panel aboard the ''Gladiator'' to release the drones; the drones then captured Golliard and brought him to the [[Swiftsure (Inexpugnable-class)|''Swiftsure'']]. Golliard was brought before Admiral Karath, who taunted him before having Golliard taken away to be court-martialed.

==Personality and traits==
Golliard was very proud of his status as Fleet Captain; he expected his commands to be obeyed to the letter and frequently threatened his subordinates with death if they displeased him. This was at odds with his previous behavior in the Great Sith War, as he was court-martialed by the Republic Navy. Despite his arrogance, Golliard had no desire to ascend in rank since he preferred to see frontline action. He was knowledgeable about naval combat and was quick to spot weaknesses in his enemies' tactics. Golliard was nevertheless tricked by the ''Hot Prospect''{{'s}} unorthodox tactics. He, however, accepted responsibility for his failures, even when faced with death.<ref name="KotOR 44" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Dace I imagined as a bit of a rumpled, ruined figure, someone who botched his career badly but who refuses to give up. He's that Texas hold'em player who's played all night to get two fives &mdash;and he's going to make you pay to see them out of spite.|John Jackson Miller|<ref name="Faraway">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor44.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #44''}}</ref>}}
Dace Golliard was created by [[John Jackson Miller]], the writer of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'']] comic series. He was drawn by [[Bong Dazo]] in [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: The Reaping|''The Reaping'']] story arc. Golliard was also penciled by [[Brian Ching]] in the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Destroyer|''Destroyer'']] story arc and the [[Knights of the Old Republic 48|second]] and [[Knights of the Old Republic 49|third]] issues of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Demon|''Demon'']] story arc. Miller has stated that Golliard was not a Fleet Captain when he was set for a court-martial by the Republic.<ref name="Faraway" />
